content_sections.text: Applicants must be at least 18 years old and must not be over the upper age limit for their post. Age is counted as on 21 December 2026, the last date to submit the online application, which is the crucial date for deciding age (Corrigendum dated 21 November 2026).

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply for CSIR Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Other conditions: Applicant must be a citizen of India Security Officer, Security Assistant/Watch & Ward Assistant and Driver posts are not suitable for PwBDs Candidate can apply for multiple post codes if eligible for each Physical standards and physical test apply to Security Officer and Security Assistant/Watch & Ward Assistant Desirable: MTS: Intermediate (12th class) pass Security Officer and Security Assistant: knowledge of local language is an added advantage

content_sections.heading: How Will CSIR Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Security Officer: qualifying physical test, then written test (Paper-I objective, Paper-II subjective) Security Assistant/Watch & Ward Assistant: Stage-I skill/physical and personality assessment test, Stage-II competitive written examination Junior Hindi Translator: open written competitive examination (Paper-I objective, Paper-II descriptive) Driver: qualifying skill test, then written test Multi-Tasking Staff: competitive written test Security Officer Paper-I threshold is 30%; final merit list is based on Paper-II Junior Hindi Translator final merit list is based only on Paper-II marks Security Assistant final merit list needs minimum threshold marks not less than 35% Ties resolved by date of birth, earlier essential degree and alphabetical order; Driver and MTS first by lesser negative marks

content_sections.heading: CSIR Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: Junior Hindi Translator, Driver and MTS: three marks per correct answer and one negative mark per wrong answer Security Officer Paper-I and Security Assistant personality test: one mark per correct answer, no negative marking Objective papers are OMR-based or computer-based, set in English and Hindi Threshold marks for Driver and MTS to be decided by the Competent Authority, CSIR

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for CSIR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 21 December 2026. Applications opened on 20 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in CSIR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 29 vacancies: 1 Security Officer (Group-B), 3 Security Assistant/Watch & Ward Assistant (Group-B), 1 Junior Hindi Translator (Group-B), 1 Driver (Group -C), 23 Multi-Tasking Staff (Non-Tech - Group C).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for CSIR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 21 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: All candidates except Women/SC/ST/PwBDs/Ex-Servicemen: Rs.500. Women/SC/ST/PwBDs/Ex-Servicemen: Exempted.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post - Security Officer (Group-B): maximum 35 years; Security Assistant/Watch & Ward Assistant (Group-B): maximum 28 years; Junior Hindi Translator (Group-B): maximum 30 years; Driver (Group -C): maximum 27 years; Multi-Tasking Staff (Non-Tech - Group C): maximum 25 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Pay Matrix Level- 7 (Rs.44900-142400 for Security Officer (Group-B), Pay Matrix Level- 6 (Rs.35400-112400 for Security Assistant/Watch & Ward Assistant (Group-B), Pay Matrix Level- 6 (Rs.35400-112400 for Junior Hindi Translator (Group-B), Pay Matrix Level -2 (Rs.19,900-Rs.63,200) for Driver (Group -C), Pay Matrix Level- 1 (Rs.18000-Rs.56900 ) for Multi-Tasking Staff (Non-Tech - Group C).

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Security Officer: ex-servicemen JCO (Subedar or higher) or equivalent with security experience. Security Assistant: ex-servicemen JCO with five years' security experience. Junior Hindi Translator: Master's degree with Hindi/English plus translation diploma or two years' experience. Driver: 10th pass, LMV and HMV licence, three years' driving experience. MTS: Matriculation or equivalent. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Applicant must be a citizen of India. Security Officer, Security Assistant/Watch & Ward Assistant and Driver posts are not suitable for PwBDs. Candidate can apply for multiple post codes if eligible for each. Physical standards and physical test apply to Security Officer and Security Assistant/Watch & Ward Assistant.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: SC/ST/OBC(NCL) candidates applying against unreserved vacancies get no age relaxation. Ex-Servicemen already employed in Group C/D civil posts after using ESM reservation are not eligible for ESM reservation and fee concession, except as the notice provides. Candidates whose application lacks the prescribed fee where exemption does not apply are rejected.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Security Officer: qualifying physical test, then written test (Paper-I objective, Paper-II subjective). Security Assistant/Watch & Ward Assistant: Stage-I skill/physical and personality assessment test, Stage-II competitive written examination. Junior Hindi Translator: open written competitive examination (Paper-I objective, Paper-II descriptive). Driver: qualifying skill test, then written test.
